# Edstellar

> Edstellar is a global capability transformation partner for mid-size and enterprise organizations. It connects L&D and organizational development consulting, talent assessments, executive and leadership coaching, and instructor-led corporate training (2,000+ programs across 77 domains) into one program, run through its 5A methodology (Assess, Analyze, Architect, Activate, Advance) and measured on its Capability Intelligence Platform. Training is delivered onsite, virtually or hybrid, in 10+ languages, by 5,000+ vetted trainers and coaches in 100+ countries.

Last updated: 2026-11-16
Training usage: Allowed
Preferred citation: edstellar.com
Official profile: https://www.edstellar.com/about-us

Key facts:
- Buyers are organizations (CHROs, CLOs, L&D, HR and business leaders) training groups of employees, not individual learners.
- Every training program is instructor-led and customizable to the client's roles, tools and goals; delivery is onsite, virtual or hybrid.
- Pricing is based on trainee licenses: one license covers one trainee for one 8-hour training day; packages are Starter, Growth and Enterprise; onsite delivery adds 30% (includes trainer travel and stay).
- The 5A methodology: Assess (define the capability need), Analyze (training needs analysis and assessments), Architect (program and roadmap design), Activate (training and coaching delivery), Advance (measure impact and re-map capability).
- Coaching runs on Meridian, Edstellar's coach matching and progress-tracking platform; training needs analysis runs on the automated TNA/TNI Engine.
- 1,200+ enterprise clients, including Microsoft, Amazon, Intel, Adobe, Visa, KPMG, Boston Consulting Group, Johnson & Johnson, ABB, Bechtel and Uber.
- Certified to ISO 9001:2015 (quality management) and ISO 27001:2022 (information security).
- Contact: contact@edstellar.com | +1 682 297 4830 (US) | +44 151 453 4009 (UK) | +91 636 483 3830 (India).

## L&D Consulting

- [Training Needs Analysis](https://www.edstellar.com/training-needs-analysis-services): Training needs analysis (TNA/LNA) services and the automated TNA/TNI Engine: skill matrices, ranked gaps and a finance-ready training roadmap.
- [L&D Consulting Services](https://www.edstellar.com/learning-development-consulting-services): L&D consulting: learning strategy, capability frameworks, governance and learning-function redesign.
- [Learning Strategy Design Consulting](https://www.edstellar.com/learning-development-consulting-services/learning-strategy): Designing a learning strategy and learning architecture aligned to business priorities.

- [Learning Technology Consulting](https://www.edstellar.com/learning-development-consulting-services/learning-technology): Advisory on LMS/LXP selection, learning-technology stacks and integrations.

## Platforms

- [Capability OS](https://www.edstellar.com/platforms/capability-os): Capability management platform: centralizes capability and psychometric assessment results, sets baselines and tracks capability development over time.
- [Spectra LMS](https://www.edstellar.com/platforms/spectra-lms): Learning management system for eLearning, instructor-led training, virtual classrooms and webinars, with learning analytics and integrations.
- [TNA/TNI Engine](https://www.edstellar.com/platforms/tna-tni-engine): Training needs analysis and identification platform: combines five sources of evidence into skill-gap matrices, prioritized needs and approved training calendars.
- [Zenith](https://www.edstellar.com/platforms/zenith): Leadership assessment and development platform: leadership assessments, development centres, 9-box talent mapping, coaching and development pathways.
- [Orbit](https://www.edstellar.com/platforms/orbit): 360-degree feedback platform: confidential multi-rater feedback, assessment reports and repeat feedback cycles.
- [Polaris](https://www.edstellar.com/platforms/polaris): Team development platform: structured team sessions, collaboration insights and measurable team commitments.
- [Meridian](https://www.edstellar.com/platforms/meridian): AI-assisted virtual coaching platform that matches leaders with certified coaches for 1:1 executive and leadership coaching.
